turns.text: I am just a poor boy

turns.zh: 虽然我的故事很少有人提起
我把自己的抵抗都耗光了

turns.text: Still a man hears what he wants to hear
turns.zh: 可人还是只听得进自己想听的

turns.text: When I left my home and my family
turns.zh: 当年我离开家、离开亲人

turns.text: I was no more than a boy
In the quiet of the railway station
turns.zh: 在火车站静悄悄的时候

turns.text: Laying low, seeking out the poorer quarters
turns.zh: 躲躲藏藏，专找最穷的街区
去那些衣衫褴褛的人待的地方

turns.text: Looking for the places only they would know
turns.zh: 找只有他们才摸得着的门路
啦—啦—啦—啦—啦—啦—啦，啦—啦—啦—啦—啦

turns.text: Asking only workman's wages, I come looking for a job
turns.zh: 只求一份工人的工钱，我来找活儿干

turns.text: Just a come-on from the whores on 7th Avenue
turns.zh: 只有第七大道上那些妓女冲我招揽

turns.text: I do declare, there were times when I was so lonesome
turns.zh: 我跟你说，有些时候我真是孤单得要命

turns.text: I took some comfort there, la-la-la-la-la-la-la
turns.zh: 我就在那儿找了点安慰，啦—啦—啦—啦—啦—啦—啦

turns.text: Then I'm laying out my winter clothes
turns.zh: 然后我翻出冬天的衣服

turns.text: And wishing I was gone, going home
Where the New York City winters aren't bleeding me
turns.zh: 那儿纽约的冬天不会把我冻得流血

turns.text: In the clearing stands a boxer
And a fighter by his trade

turns.zh: 他身上带着一道道印记

turns.text: Of every glove that laid him down
turns.zh: 每一只把他打倒的拳套
